title: Is There Any Deity with Allah?

paragraphs.text: Lot spoke to his people about their shameful deeds, which they did openly. They approached men with desire instead of women, and he called them a people acting in ignorance. Their only answer was to say, "Drive Lot's family out of your city, because they keep themselves pure." So Allah saved him and his family, except his wife, who stayed behind. Then a rain of stones fell upon those who had been warned.

The Prophet is told to praise Allah and to send peace upon His chosen servants. Then come a series of strong questions. Who created the heavens and the earth and sent down rain to grow beautiful gardens, which people could never grow by themselves? Who made the earth steady, placed rivers and firm mountains in it, and set a barrier between the two seas? Who answers the desperate person when he calls, removes harm, and makes people inheritors of the earth? Who guides people through the darkness of land and sea, and sends the winds as good news before His mercy? Who begins creation, repeats it, and provides for everyone? After each question comes the same challenge: is there any deity with Allah? Those who say so are asked to bring their proof.

No one in the heavens or the earth knows the unseen except Allah, and people do not know when they will be raised up again. Their knowledge of the Hereafter has failed; they are in doubt and blind about it. The disbelievers ask whether they and their forefathers will really come out of the earth after becoming dust. They say these are only old stories. The Prophet is told to tell them to travel and see the end of the criminals, and not to grieve over their plots.
